title: 10 Questions to Ask Before Replacing Your Home’s Siding
summary: Thinking about replacing your home’s siding? Ask these 10 important questions before starting your siding project to choose the right material, improve curb appeal, and protect your home for years to come.
body_markdown:
Replacing your home’s siding is one of the most significant exterior improvement projects. New siding can transform curb appeal, improve weather protection, and reduce maintenance demands for years to come. However, choosing the right siding isn’t just about selecting a color or material. Asking the right questions before making a decision can help you avoid costly mistakes and find a solution that fits your home’s long-term goals.


Before you begin your siding remodel or replacement project, consider these important questions.


**Why Am I Replacing My Siding?**


Understanding your motivation can help guide the entire project from start to finish. Are you replacing siding because of storm damage, recurring maintenance issues, fading paint, or moisture and durability concerns?


Identifying the primary reason for replacement will help determine which features of a product, matter most. It can be impact resistance, low maintenance, aesthetics, or long-term performance that steer you towards a certain type of siding.


**What Signs Indicate My Siding Has Reached the End of Life?**


Not all siding problems require a full replacement. Before making a major investment, inspect your home’s exterior for:


-


Cracks or splits


-


Warping


-


Buckling


-


Fungal decay


-


Moisture damage


-


Repainting needs


-


Loose or missing panels


If multiple issues are present, a siding replacement may be more cost-effective than ongoing repairs.


**What Siding Material is Best for My Climate?**


Weather plays a major role in siding performance. Homeowners should consider local conditions such as:


-


Humidity levels


-


Heavy rainfall


-


Freezing temperatures


-


Strong winds


-


Hail exposure


-


Intense UV rays


Different siding materials offer varying levels of durability and weather resistance. For example, engineered wood products like LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding are manufactured to help withstand hail, moisture, fungal decay, and many weather conditions while offering the natural beauty of traditional wood.


Choosing a siding product designed for your local climate can help maximize its longevity and performance.


**How Much Maintenance Am I Willing to Do?**


Every siding material requires some level of upkeep.


Homeowners should ask:


-


How often do I want to repaint my siding?


-


Am I comfortable performing routine exterior maintenance?


-


Would I prefer a factory-finished product?


For homeonwers seeking long-lasting curb appeal, products such as LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Trim & Siding, feature a factory-applied finish available in a variety of colors, and helps eliminate field painting while maintaining a consistent appearance.


**What Is My Budget Beyond Installation Costs?**


The initial installation price is only part of the total cost of ownership.


When comparing siding products to replace your current siding with, consider:


-


Maintenance expenses


-


Future repainting costs


-


Repair frequency


-


Durability and longevity


-


Warranty coverage


A siding product with a higher upfront investment could provide greater long-term value if it requires fewer repairs and less maintenance over time. Looking at the total lifecycle of cost instead of just the replacement purchase price can provide a complete picture of your investment.


**How Will New Siding Affect My Home’s Appearance?**


Siding is often a huge visual feature of a home’s exterior. Before making a decision, think about how your new siding will complement other aspects of your home.


-


Architectural style


-


Roof color


-


Exterior trim


-


Stone or brick accents


-


Landscaping


-


Window and door color


Looking at complete homes with similar designs can help you visualize the finished result.


Use the[LP® SmartSide® Home Visualizer](https://homevisualizer.lpcorp.com/?_gl=1*1lixc0q*_gcl_au*MjEwNzc2ODY5LjE3ODcwNjQyODA.) to explore the full LP® SmartSide® product line, switch between different lap, panel, shake, and trim styles, and test different combinations on your own home.


**Could There Be Hidden Issues Beneath My Existing Siding?**


Removing old siding can expose underlying problems that were not visible before.


-


Water intrusion


-


Insect damage


-


Insufficient weather barriers


Discuss potential hidden repairs with your contractor ahead of time so you can plan for potential issues and avoid project delays.


**What Warranty Protection Is Available?**


A siding warranty can provide valuable peace of mind, but not all warranties offer the same level of protection.


Before choosing a siding product:


-


How long is the warranty?


-


What all is covered?


-


Is the finish/paint protected?


-


Is the warranty transferable?


LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Trim & Siding is backed by a limited warranty that includes coverage for both the substrate and finish, helping homeowners feel more confident in their purchase. Reviewing warranty details can help you compare products beyond just appearance and aesthetics.


*Refer to limited warranty at*[lpcorp.com/literature](https://lpcorp.com/literature) *for complete details, including important limitations and exclusions.*


**What Feature Matters Most for My Home and Lifestyle?**


Not every homeowner has the same priorities when replacing siding. Before comparing products, think about what matters most to you over a long-term period.


Ask yourself:


-


Do I want a low-maintenance exterior?


-


How important is durability?


-


Am I looking for authentic wood aesthetics?


-


Do I want factory-applied colors?


-


How important is warranty coverage?


-


Am I planning to stay in my home for years?


Understanding your priorities can make it easier to evaluate siding options. Homeowners who want the warmth and appearance of wood with added durability can consider LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding or LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Trim & Siding which comes prefinished in 16 different colors.


**Have I Chosen the Right Contractor?**


Even the best siding products rely on proper installation to deliver high performance.


A qualified contractor can help ensure siding is installed according to manufacturer specifications and local building codes.


A few questions homeowners should ask:


-


Are you licensed and insured?


-


Do you have experience installing siding?


-


Can you provide references?


-


What is included in the estimate?


If you’re considering products such as LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding, working with a qualified contractor can help ensure your home’s exterior performs as intended.


Replacing your home’s siding is an opportunity to improve curb appeal, enhance durability, and protect your home for years to come. By asking these 10 questions before starting your remodel or re-siding project, you will be better positioned to choose a siding solution that aligns with your home’s needs, budget, climate, and long-term goals.
